description: The demo recorder's perspective fixture (demo-recorder-perspective-streams.md). The human's commander stands at the camera's centre, two Peewees north-west of it inside the drag box the fixture draws, and nothing else of the human's on screen; the AI's one solar is far away, so no unit dies. The fixture's keys move the pointer, left-click the commander, right-click the ground, drag-select the Peewees, scroll with an arrow key and turn the wheel once. The camera is not pinned, so the scroll moves it.
